articles.summary: Bio-Rad Laboratories, Inc. (NYSE: BIO and BIO.B), a global leader in life science research and clinical diagnostics products, today announced financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026. Norman Schwartz, Bio-Rad’s Chief Executive Officer, stated: “Our third-quarter results reflect the steady progress we have been driving. We returned to currency-neutral revenue growth, led by Clinical Diagnostics and strong demand for our Droplet Digital™ PCR instruments. Excluding restructuring and impairment items, margins expanded, reflecting benefits of our transformation initiatives. The reprioritization of our RD efforts is yielding new, differentiated products for our customers, and our progress gives us confidence in our 2026 outlook.” Financial Results Highlights (In millions, except per share data and percentages) GAAP Results Q3 2026 Q3 2025 Net sales $ 656.4 $ 653.0 Gross margin 50.1 % 52.6 % Income (loss) from operations $ (49.7 ) $ 65.3 Operating margin (7.6 )%
articles.title: Bio-Rad Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Financial Results
